negatives.operation: parallel frozen-history and tooling audit bundle
negatives.failure_signature: The five-command parent envelope reached its 20-second limit before returning complete, attributable child receipts.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Proposal discovery, script discovery, document discovery, and Method Flow help shared one short parent window on a large D-drive checkout.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout and changed to bounded single-surface reads with explicit per-command windows.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not combine large recursive searches and runner startup under a shorter shared envelope; retain each independently completed receipt.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; only the later complete bounded audit slices may support x1

negatives.failure_signature: A login-shell Get-ChildItem listing reached its 10-second limit without returning the directory entries.
negatives.trigger_precondition: The command inherited login-shell startup cost and a window too short for the observed host latency.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout and used a non-login bounded directory enumeration, then continued with exact allowlisted reads.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Use non-login shells and measured windows for D-drive metadata reads; do not promote output from a timed-out listing.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the later complete listing is the only directory-discovery witness

negatives.failure_signature: Ripgrep rejected a PowerShell-escaped alternation as an unclosed regular-expression group.
negatives.trigger_precondition: A JSON-like quoted pattern was escaped for the orchestration string and then interpreted again by PowerShell before reaching ripgrep.
negatives.recovery: Retained the parser fault and changed to a literal-safe single-quoted pattern against the exact proposal file.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Prefer fixed strings or single-quoted regex patterns for JSON field probes; validate the pattern separately before including it in a larger audit.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the rejected probe produced no proposal evidence

negatives.operation: inline Python frozen-index extractor through PowerShell
negatives.failure_signature: PowerShell altered nested f-string quoting and Python rejected the resulting one-line program as an unterminated string literal.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Python source containing nested quoted dictionary lookups was embedded in a PowerShell command inside an orchestration string.
negatives.recovery: Retained the syntax failure and changed to a PowerShell-only JSON chain walk with no embedded Python source.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not place nested Python f-strings behind two command parsers; prefer one-language structured traversal or a committed reusable script.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the rejected program emitted no frozen-proposal records

negatives.failure_signature: PowerShell rejected a direct pipeline from a foreach statement with EmptyPipeElement.
negatives.trigger_precondition: The report attempted to pipe statement output without first collecting it as an expression or array.
negatives.recovery: Retained the parser fault and wrapped the loop output in an explicit array before JSON serialization.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Collect statement output before piping on Windows PowerShell; do not infer any similarity result from a parser-rejected report.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; no candidate comparison was emitted

negatives.failure_signature: Apply-patch rejected the full change atomically because one copied version field no longer matched the predecessor context.
negatives.trigger_precondition: A large patch mixed still-stale predecessor fields with a field already changed by the mechanical version rewrite.
negatives.recovery: Retained the rejected patch and changed to smaller exact-context semantic patches after inspecting the current UTF-8 source.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Inspect the post-rewrite source and patch independent semantic regions with exact current context; never infer a partial apply from an atomic rejection.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the rejected patch changed no file

negatives.operation: second combined builder patch using console-rendered Unicode context
negatives.failure_signature: Apply-patch rejected the change because the displayed dash sequence did not match the UTF-8 source bytes.
negatives.trigger_precondition: A Unicode heading separator copied from console output was included as context beside unrelated ASCII changes.
negatives.recovery: Retained the rejection, separated ASCII-only regions, and reserved the Unicode line for an exact encoded-source patch.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not copy non-ASCII patch context from a mojibake-prone console; inspect exact UTF-8 source and patch that region independently.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the rejected patch changed no file

negatives.failure_signature: Git staged the exact file set but warned that LF working-copy bytes may be replaced by CRLF on a later Git touch for multiple new text files.
negatives.trigger_precondition: The Windows checkout has line-ending conversion behavior while generated files and the exact content seal are defined over normalized Git blobs.
negatives.recovery: Retained the warnings and required explicit staged-blob newline, diff-check, content-seal, and later LF-preserving named-lane witnesses.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat Git blobs as the manifest domain, inspect CRLF and LF counts explicitly, and never equate a warning-bearing working copy with cross-checkout byte parity without a clean named replay.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; staging success alone does not establish newline portability or replay parity

retention_rule: Recovery does not erase failure evidence; only successful corrected runs may be promoted.
